instruction.name: xvpickve2gr.d
instruction.description: Pick the 64-bit element at lane `idx` from `a`, sign-extend it to the GPR width, and store it in `dst`.

experiments.name: round trip through the reverse move
experiments.notes: Round trip 7.01 cycles. xvreplgr2vr.d is 1 cycle, so xvpickve2gr.d is 6.01 cycles.

latencies.notes: Round trip 7.01 cycles. xvreplgr2vr.d is 1 cycle, so xvpickve2gr.d is 6.01 cycles. Nominal values: round-trip core cycles rounded to the nearest integer.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvpickve2gr.d $r12, $xr8, 0; xvpickve2gr.d $r13, $xr9, 0; xvpickve2gr.d $r14, $xr10, 0; xvpickve2gr.d $r15, $xr11, 0; xvpickve2gr.d $r16, $xr12, 0; xvpickve2gr.d $r17, $xr13, 0; xvpickve2gr.d $r18, $xr14, 0; xvpickve2gr.d $r19, $xr15, 0
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 2; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 3; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 4; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 5; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 6; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 7; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 8; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr15, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --counter 0xfa --init 'li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 2; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 3; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 4; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 5; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 6; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 7; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 8; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr15, $r4' --asm 'xvpickve2gr.d $r12, $xr8, 0; xvpickve2gr.d $r13, $xr9, 0; xvpickve2gr.d $r14, $xr10, 0; xvpickve2gr.d $r15, $xr11, 0; xvpickve2gr.d $r16, $xr12, 0; xvpickve2gr.d $r17, $xr13, 0; xvpickve2gr.d $r18, $xr14, 0; xvpickve2gr.d $r19, $xr15, 0'
throughput.notes: 8 independent instructions take 7.99 cycles. Counter 0xfa is normalised per instruction.

notes: LASX two-uop instruction. Individual latency is not separable without a round trip through the reverse move; throughput is measured with 8 independent lanes. Extra counter 0xfa records the classified uop count.
